scope: Original workload opcode/operand-shape/modifier profiles, including both VOPD component slots. This index validates frontend and lowering forms; it does not execute the workloads.
profile_identity: Mnemonic, typed family, operand shapes, exact named modifier values and optional VOPD slot. Register indices and immediate data values remain source-specific; their legality/semantics are never generalized from a shape.

hardware_abi.scope: Only the compiler's HW_REG_IB_STS2 offset6 width4 read is modeled in the selected unsplit launch profile. Other hardware fields never receive a fabricated zero; no general hardware-register model is claimed.
hardware_abi.control_scope: Named controls test the selected semantic family. They do not establish execution of every indexed PC or arbitrary immediate/modifier combinations.

scalar.scope: Exact concrete integer/bit/carry and typed mathematical scalar data; opaque address and SCC restrictions remain explicit.
scalar.control_scope: Named controls test the selected semantic family. They do not establish execution of every indexed PC or arbitrary immediate/modifier combinations.

vector.scope: Selected per-lane integer and mathematical-real forms, finite raw storage conversions and exact partial-register effects; VOPD reads a pre-issue snapshot. No IEEE exceptional/rounding proof.
vector.control_scope: Named controls test the selected semantic family. They do not establish execution of every indexed PC or arbitrary immediate/modifier combinations.

memory.scope: Actual byte widths, per-component scalar address masking after register scaling, encoded nonnegative scalar offsets, configured allocations/subobjects, initialized data, source leases and native completion classes. Scope annotations do not create happens-before or whole-device guarantees.
memory.control_scope: Named controls test the selected semantic family. They do not establish execution of every indexed PC or arbitrary immediate/modifier combinations.

permutation.scope: Wave32 source-lane exchange with its DS readiness dependency; no invented LDS memory access or publication.
permutation.control_scope: Named controls test the selected semantic family. They do not establish execution of every indexed PC or arbitrary immediate/modifier combinations.

atomic.scope: Selected no-return F32 RMW consumes initialized inout value, preserves its full footprint and separates translation/data completion.
atomic.control_scope: Named controls test the selected semantic family. They do not establish execution of every indexed PC or arbitrary immediate/modifier combinations.

branch.scope: Concrete native SCC/EXEC/VCC and resolved label control; symbolic data-dependent control and exhausted execution budgets cannot certify completion.
branch.control_scope: Named controls test the selected semantic family. They do not establish execution of every indexed PC or arbitrary immediate/modifier combinations.

control.scope: Selected nop/delay/clause/end controls retain issue/termination records. Delay instructions never substitute data completion or WMMA VALU spacing.
control.control_scope: Named controls test the selected semantic family. They do not establish execution of every indexed PC or arbitrary immediate/modifier combinations.

wait.scope: Exact target-selected load/store/DS/KM/X counter thresholds; replay-source retirement does not fabricate data completion.
wait.control_scope: Named controls test the selected semantic family. They do not establish execution of every indexed PC or arbitrary immediate/modifier combinations.

barrier.scope: Native unnamed shader split signal/wait across actual live waves; only completed effects publish and issue order cannot fabricate a wait.
barrier.control_scope: Named controls test the selected semantic family. They do not establish execution of every indexed PC or arbitrary immediate/modifier combinations.

matrix.scope: Actual complete-wave native F16 WMMA 16x16x32 register fragments, input snapshots, accumulator/result layouts and independent readiness windows.
matrix.control_scope: Named controls test the selected semantic family. They do not establish execution of every indexed PC or arbitrary immediate/modifier combinations.

release.scope: Only terminal MSG_DEALLOC_VGPRS with zero scratch and following END; X leases drain without inventing data completion.
release.control_scope: Named controls test the selected semantic family. They do not establish execution of every indexed PC or arbitrary immediate/modifier combinations.
